# middmonitor_alert_rule (Resource)

A threshold rule evaluated every minute. Set `metric` for a built-in signal (`cpu`, `ram`, `disk`, `latency`, `error_count`, `failure_rate`) or `custom_metric` to watch a scraped series, which is what an agent scrape produces.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A rule on a series the agent scrapes, warning then critical, with hysteresis
# on the way back down.
resource "middmonitor_alert_rule" "load" {
  name          = "Load average high"
  custom_metric = "node_load1"

  custom_labels = {
    instance = "10.0.1.5:9100"
  }

  target_type = "host"
  target_id   = middmonitor_host.web1.id

  aggregation        = "avg"
  operator           = "gt"
  warning_threshold  = 4
  critical_threshold = 8
  recovery_threshold = 3
  duration           = 300

  channels = [middmonitor_notification_channel.automation.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Rule name. It becomes the incident title.
- `operator` (String) `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte` or `eq`.

### Optional

- `aggregation` (String) `avg` (default), `min`, `max`, `sum`, `p50`, `p75`, `p90`, `p95`, `p99`.
- `channels` (List of Number) Notification channel IDs. Empty means every enabled channel of the organization.
- `critical_threshold` (Number) Raises a critical alert when crossed. Wins over the warning threshold.
- `custom_labels` (Map of String) Label equality constraints narrowing the custom metric series.
- `custom_metric` (String) Name of a scraped or SDK-reported series, e.g. `node_load1`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `duration` (Number) Evaluation window in seconds. Defaults to 300.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to true.
- `metric` (String) Built-in signal: `cpu`, `ram`, `disk`, `latency`, `error_count`, `failure_rate`. Leave unset when using `custom_metric`.
- `notify_critical` (Boolean) Deliver critical-severity alerts on these channels. Defaults to true.
- `notify_warning` (Boolean) Deliver warning-severity alerts on these channels. Defaults to true.
- `recovery_threshold` (Number) Hysteresis: the incident resolves only once the value crosses back past this.
- `severity` (String) Severity of the single-threshold form: `warning` or `critical`.
- `target_id` (Number) The service or host the rule is scoped to, when `target_type` is not `any`.
- `target_type` (String) `any` (default), `service` or `host`.
- `threshold` (Number) Single threshold. Ignored when `warning_threshold` or `critical_threshold` is set.
- `warning_threshold` (Number) Raises a warning when crossed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Alert rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import middmonitor_alert_rule.example 42
```
